operation_details.item: The user prefers passive indirect phrasing in post-demo follow-up emails with no clear next step, meeting request, or deadline.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s your Thursday going? Are you working through follow-ups after any client demos today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I’m drafting a few post-demo emails this afternoon.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Do you usually make those emails direct and action-oriented, or keep the tone more open-ended?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I prefer passive, indirect phrasing. I don’t want to include a clear next step, meeting request, or deadline.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives the client more space to respond on their own terms. Do you want the message to focus mainly on appreciation and keeping the conversation warm?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I want it to sound thoughtful and low-pressure rather than pushing the deal forward.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that For follow-up emails after demos, I want passive indirect phrasing with no clear next step, meeting request, or deadline.
